_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. `Puzzle5dMutation` is a semio-NATIVE vocabulary carried in `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio`, so no oracle is registered and the decision below records what stands in for one.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: No third-party library reads or writes semio's own `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio` envelope, and none is authoritative over `Puzzle5dMutation` — a vocabulary in which ONE part carries BOTH a 2d and a 3d facet, so `move-part2d` and `move-part3d` are different kinds addressing different halves of the same record, and in which `kindCompatibility` is a TOP-LEVEL field rather than a member of `meta` as it is in the sibling 2d and 3d subsets. That is this subset's own specification, not a fact an external library could confirm or refute. Confidence comes instead from the committed specification vectors under `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/<kind>/🧪️tests/<fixture>/` — one handcrafted `(before, mutation, diff, outcome, after)` quintet per kind, already unit-tested inside the production crate — replayed end-to-end through the test platform here, plus two metamorphic laws asserted in role: observability (a kind must move the compared projection, or, where the committed outcome itself declares `mutation.no-op`, must provably move nothing) and footprint completeness (`before` and `after` may differ on exactly the fields the committed diff declares).
